name: SyncScript Django Backend User Authentication System

userStories.title: User Registration with Email Verification
userStories.description: As a new researcher, I want to register an account with email verification so that I can securely access SyncScript's knowledge vaults
acceptanceCriteria: User submits email, password, optional profile fields (bio, institution)
System validates email uniqueness and password strength
Verification email sent via Django's email backend
User clicks verification link to activate account
Unverified users cannot access protected endpoints
Registration rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP

userStories.title: JWT-Based Login and Token Management
userStories.description: As a registered user, I want to login with email/password and receive JWT tokens so that I can authenticate subsequent API requests securely
acceptanceCriteria: Login endpoint accepts email + password
Returns access token (15min expiry) + refresh token (7 day expiry)
Access token stored in response body for mobile clients
Refresh token optionally stored in httpOnly cookie
Failed login attempts rate-limited (5/minute)
Tokens include user ID and email claims
Login rate-limited to 5 attempts/minute per IP

userStories.title: Token Refresh and Logout
userStories.description: As an authenticated user, I want to refresh my access token without re-login and logout securely so that my session remains valid and I can terminate sessions cleanly
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh endpoint accepts refresh token, returns new access token
Blacklist tracks revoked refresh tokens (djangorestframework-simplejwt)
Logout endpoint blacklists current refresh token
Blacklist stored in database (SimpleJWT default) with expiry cleanup
Refresh token rotation: old token invalidated when new one issued

userStories.title: Password Reset Flow
userStories.description: As a user who forgot their password, I want to request a password reset via email so that I can regain access to my account
acceptanceCriteria: Forgot Password endpoint accepts email address
System generates secure reset token using Django's PasswordResetTokenGenerator
Email sent with reset link containing token and user ID (base64 encoded)
Reset link valid for 1 hour
Reset Password endpoint validates token and updates password
Rate-limited to 3 reset requests per email per hour
No user enumeration (always return success message)

userStories.title: User Profile Management
userStories.description: As an authenticated user, I want to view and update my profile (avatar URL, bio, institution) so that I can personalize my researcher identity
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/users/profile/ returns own profile
PATCH /api/v1/users/profile/ updates avatar_url, bio, institution
Cannot update email or password via this endpoint (separate flows)
Avatar URL validated as proper URL format
Bio limited to 500 characters
Institution limited to 200 characters

userStories.title: Create Custom User Model and EmailVerificationToken Model
userStories.description: Create custom User model extending AbstractUser with profile fields and EmailVerificationToken model for email verification
acceptanceCriteria: User model created with email, avatar_url, bio, institution, email_verified fields
EmailVerificationToken model created with user FK, token, created_at, expires_at
Models include proper indexes (email, email_verified)
USERNAME_FIELD set to email
Database migrations generated and applied

userStories.title: Configure Django Settings for Authentication
userStories.description: Update settings.py with AUTH_USER_MODEL, SimpleJWT configuration, and Redis cache backend
acceptanceCriteria: AUTH_USER_MODEL set to 'users.User'
SimpleJWT settings configured (15min access, 7 day refresh, rotation enabled)
BLACKLIST_AFTER_ROTATION enabled
Redis cache backend configured
Email backend configured with environment variables

userStories.title: Create Serializers for Authentication
userStories.description: Create RegisterSerializer, UserSerializer, ProfileUpdateSerializer, PasswordResetRequestSerializer, PasswordResetConfirmSerializer
acceptanceCriteria: RegisterSerializer validates email uniqueness and password strength
UserSerializer for profile responses
ProfileUpdateSerializer for PATCH operations
Password validators enforce minimum 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit
Custom validators for bio length (500 chars), avatar URL format

userStories.title: Implement Email Verification System
userStories.description: Create token generation, verification email templates, and VerifyEmailView endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Token generation uses cryptographically secure secrets.token_urlsafe
Verification email template created (HTML + plain text)
send_verification_email() helper function in emails.py
VerifyEmailView validates token and activates account
Tokens expire after 24 hours
Expired tokens rejected with appropriate error

userStories.title: Create Registration and Login Views
userStories.description: Implement RegisterView, LoginView, LogoutView, and RefreshTokenView with rate limiting
acceptanceCriteria: RegisterView creates user and sends verification email
LoginView returns JWT tokens and user data
LogoutView blacklists refresh token
RefreshTokenView issues new access token
Rate limiting applied (5/min for register, 5/min for login, 20/min for refresh)
Rate limits enforced via Redis backend

userStories.title: Implement Password Reset Flow
userStories.description: Create PasswordResetRequestView and PasswordResetConfirmView with email templates
acceptanceCriteria: PasswordResetRequestView generates secure token using Django's PasswordResetTokenGenerator
Password reset email sent with token link (1 hour expiry)
PasswordResetConfirmView validates token and updates password
Rate-limited to 3 requests/hour per email
No user enumeration (always return success)
Expired tokens rejected

userStories.title: Create Profile Management Endpoint
userStories.description: Implement ProfileView (GET/PATCH) for user profile management
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/users/profile/ returns authenticated user's profile
PATCH updates avatar_url, bio, institution fields only
Email and password updates blocked via this endpoint
IsAuthenticated permission enforced
Unauthorized users receive 401 response

userStories.title: Configure URL Routing
userStories.description: Create apps/users/urls.py and include in config/urls.py
acceptanceCriteria: All auth endpoints mapped to correct paths (/api/v1/auth/*, /api/v1/users/*)
URL patterns properly named for reverse lookups
OPTIONS requests return allowed methods
URLs included in main config/urls.py

userStories.title: Configure Rate Limiting with Redis
userStories.description: Configure Redis cache backend and apply @ratelimit decorators to auth views
acceptanceCriteria: Redis connection configured in settings.py CACHES
@ratelimit decorators applied to all auth views
Rate limits stored in Redis
429 status returned when limit exceeded
Limits reset after time window expires

userStories.title: Write Comprehensive Test Suite
userStories.description: Create unit and integration tests for models, serializers, views, and rate limiting
acceptanceCriteria: Model tests: User creation, email uniqueness
Serializer tests: validation rules, password strength
Auth flow tests: register → verify → login → refresh → logout
Rate limiting tests with mocked Redis
Password reset end-to-end tests
Profile CRUD tests
Test coverage >90%

userStories.title: Documentation and Deployment Preparation
userStories.description: Create API documentation, update environment variable examples, and manual verification checklist
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI/Swagger schema documented
Environment variables added to .env.example
MANUAL_VERIFICATION.md updated with email testing steps
USER_SETUP.md updated with email backend configuration
Django admin interface configured for User model
All 9 API endpoints documented with request/response examples
